news.title: Sexual favor scandal revives doubts over Korea's historic 2002 World Cup semifinal run
news.lede: Police officers leave the Korea Football Association (KFA) headquarters in Seoul, Friday, after searching the office to investigate whether KFA executives unlawfully intervened in the hiring process of former national team head coach Hong Myung-bo. Yonhap The disclosure of the national football association’s alleged provision of sexual entertainment to foreign referees between 2011 and 2012 is expanding beyond national disgrace toward doubts over the legitimacy of Korea’s landmark 2002 World Cup semifinal advancement. It has revived the 24-year-old suspicions that the Korean national team had been favored during the World Cup matches and thus gained the exceptional result, although there is no ground to back the suspicion of any illegality involved.

news.title: [ED] Korean football needs reckoning, not another apology
news.lede: The area around Korea Football Park in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, was quiet Thursday as police conducted a search and seizure of the Korea Football Association. Police began the operation at about 9 a.m., sending all employees outside. Yonhap The Korea Football Association (KFA) has apologized. Following Korea’s disappointing 2026 World Cup campaign, a parliamentary hearing, a police search of KFA headquarters and renewed scrutiny of long-buried allegations, the KFA has acknowledged that public trust in the institution has been badly damaged.

news.title: Infantino admits World Cup sell-off ‘errors’ but wins full backing to stay FIFA president
news.lede: Rabat (IANS): Gianni Infantino admitted mistakes were made in the process of trying to sell off the World Cup to private investment and apologised for "errors" he made, but the senior executives "reaffirmed their full support" for him to remain FIFA president after a crisis meeting in Morocco. . Infantino was forced to withdraw his plan to create FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE), a company to run the commercial and operational aspects of FIFA's tournaments, after it triggered widespread opposition from UEFA, Concacaf, the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) and several national associations, as well as criticism from within FIFA.. Secretary general Mattias Grafstrom, who was at Wednesday's meeting, wrote in an internal memo sent to Fifa staff on Tuesday that the situation is "a sad and reproachable series of events"..

news.title: India women’s football: Why the World Cup dream is being held back
news.lede: CHENNAI: India’s women’s football team is closer to the FIFA Women’s World Cup than it has been in years.. While the debate around Indian football has largely centred on why the men continue to miss out, the women have quietly built a far more promising pathway. For the first time in nearly two decades, India’s senior, U-20 and U-17 women’s teams have all qualified for the AFC Asian Cup through qualifiersYet, as the team has begun to find its footing, the ecosystem has become increasingly unstable. So much so that even the kits sent were ill-fitted, and were manufactured for age-group teams.“.

news.title: FIFA World Cup Revenue Hits $15 Billion, Doubles Games
news.lede: FIFA is about to announce a significant increase in revenue for the latest World Cup cycle, totaling an impressive $15 billion. This amount not only doubles the revenue from previous cycles but also significantly exceeds the projected $11 billion. The surge in revenue highlights the robust health and ongoing expansion of global football. In light of this financial success, the Women’s World Cup slated for 2031 will expand its format, increasing from 32 to 48 teams.

news.title: Asamoah Gyan: 2010 Fifa World Cup penalty miss was a blessing in disguise
news.lede: Retired Ghana football national team captain Asamoah Gyan addresses the media at Nyayo National Stadium on August 2, 2026. Asamoah Gyan now spots a small pot belly. It is most noticeable when he slips into one of his sharp suits, where the tailored drape is forced to negotiate a slight midsection. Yet, the drip remains unmistakably fashionable.

news.title: Criticism is brewing overseas over the Korea Football Association (KFA), which revealed sexual enter..
news.lede: Criticism is brewing overseas over the Korea Football Association (KFA), which revealed sexual entertainment to foreign referees in the past. Despite the dark administration in the process of appointing a director, the subsequent failure of North American World Cup, and the impact of sexual hospitality, the apology focused on "promise to prevent recurrence" is causing public anger. On the 8th, the Korea Football Association issued a statement saying, "I am very sorry for the deep disappointment and concern caused by various controversies surrounding the Korea Football Association since the end of the 2026 North American World Cup."

news.title: World Cup inspired fixture considered to shake-up grand final weekend
news.lede: The league could be set to see the grand final weekend turn into a festival of football with three additional matches in frame to take place before the decider. Nine’s Danny Weidler reports the NRL are considering adding a third-place play-off, an under-21s game and an All-Stars game to take place over the three days leading into the premiership match on Sunday, October 4. The Broncos are the reigning premiers of the NRL Getty. Bulldogs boss Aaron Warburton flagged the idea in the NRL’s chief executive meeting this week, drawing inspiration from the FIFA World Cup last month.
